title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, start by drawing the first loop which consists of an arc starting at coordinates (0.0, 0.0462), passing through (0.0462, 0.0), and ending at (0.0923, 0.0462). From there, draw a line to (0.0923, 0.3865), followed by another arc starting at (0.0923, 0.3865), passing through (0.0779, 0.4096), and ending at (0.0923, 0.4327). Continue with a line to (0.0923, 0.7038), then an arc starting at (0.0923, 0.7038), passing through (0.0462, 0.6577), and ending at (0.0, 0.7038). Finally, draw a line back to (0.0, 0.0462). In the second loop, draw a circle centered at (0.0462, 0.7038) with a radius of 0.0231. For the third loop, draw a circle centered at (0.0462, 0.5654) with a radius of 0.0202. In the fourth loop, draw a circle centered at (0.0462, 0.0462) with a radius of 0.0144. Lastly, in the fifth loop, draw a circle centered at (0.0462, 0.1846) with a radius of 0.0144. After completing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.7269 to the entire 2D sketch. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the 2D sketch 0.0173 units in the direction of the normal to create a new solid body. The dimensions of the part are 0.0923 meters in length, 0.7269 meters in width, and 0.0173 meters in height.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
wp = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
sketch = wp.moveTo(0.0, 0.0462) \
           .threePointArc((0.0462, 0.0), (0.0923, 0.0462)) \
           .lineTo(0.0923, 0.3865) \
           .threePointArc((0.0779, 0.4096), (0.0923, 0.4327)) \
           .lineTo(0.0923, 0.7038) \
           .threePointArc((0.0462, 0.6577), (0.0, 0.7038)) \
           .lineTo(0.0, 0.0462) \
           .close()

# Add holes
sketch = sketch.circle(0.0231, (0.0462, 0.7038)) \
               .circle(0.0202, (0.0462, 0.5654)) \
               .circle(0.0144, (0.0462, 0.0462)) \
               .circle(0.0144, (0.0462, 0.1846))

# Extrude the sketch
r = sketch.extrude(0.0173)

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

W = 0.0923        # width in X
L = 0.7038        # length in Y
T = 0.0173        # thickness in Z
R = W / 2.0       # end radius
r_n = 0.012       # side notch radius
y_n = 0.408       # side notch center height

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, R)
    .threePointArc((W / 2.0, 0.0), (W, R))            # rounded bottom end
    .lineTo(W, y_n - r_n)                             # right edge up to notch
    .threePointArc((W - r_n, y_n), (W, y_n + r_n))    # side notch (concave)
    .lineTo(W, L)                                     # right edge to top
    .threePointArc((W / 2.0, L - R), (0.0, L))        # concave semicircular top cut
    .lineTo(0.0, R)                                   # left edge down
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

W = 0.0923
L = 0.7038
T = 0.0173
end_r = W / 2.0

# Straight rectangular portion above the rounded lower end
rect = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(W, L - end_r)
    .extrude(T)
    .translate((W / 2.0, end_r + (L - end_r) / 2.0, 0))
)

# Rounded lower end
lower_round = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(end_r, end_r)
    .circle(end_r)
    .extrude(T)
)

r = rect.union(lower_round)

# Concave semicircular cutout at the far/top end
top_cut = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(end_r, L)
    .circle(end_r)
    .extrude(T * 2.0)
    .translate((0, 0, -T / 2.0))
)
r = r.cut(top_cut)

# Small semicircular notch in one long edge
side_r = 0.010
side_y = 0.430
side_cut = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(W, side_y)
    .circle(side_r)
    .extrude(T * 2.0)
    .translate((0, 0, -T / 2.0))
)
r = r.cut(side_cut)
